current.text: He is expected to start for the Warriors. The latest lineup reports have him starting with Podziemski and Curry, at center, with no Horford in the lineup.
Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody are out early in the season. Their returns could change the Warriors' rotation.

Experts are cool on him. One has no interest in drafting him around pick 132, another is souring on him, and a third ranks him outside the top 120 in categories because of his age and because he fades when Curry sits. A Yahoo ADP of 107 is called too high.
Experts see value in him only late in deep leagues, around picks 160 to 180. They would not take him in round 13 of a 12-team league or at all in 10-team leagues.
The Warriors may treat this as a gap year. They are worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Warriors' schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.
His value comes from rebounds and assists. His assists are rare for a forward or center. His steals and blocks are now modest.
His production drops when Steph Curry sits.
His age makes a decline in role and production likely.

note: Yahoo rank 151 and ESPN rank 163 put him at the very edge of our 144-player draft, and both sites price him at about 1 USD (Yahoo 1.0, ESPN 0.3). Our league paid 4 USD for him last season. Take him only as a 1 USD final pick for a build that needs assists from F/C and can absorb his weak points, FG% (43.5%) and turnovers (2.5 per game). Otherwise leave him on waivers. Early in the season, check whether he keeps starting at center, how his minutes change when Butler and Moody return, and how often Golden State rests him.
